title: Pull and release
description: A satin sphere and its ground shadow turn a bounded pull into a finite rebound.
useCase: Playful direct manipulation and a tangible release response.
reducedMotion: Releasing returns directly to rest with no flight.
limitations: Authored bounded rebound keyframes, not a general physics engine.
look: Plain warm off-white canvas with a single satin coral-red sphere, soft specular highlight and a blurred contact shadow beneath.
motion: Drag pulls the ball up to 65 px; release flings it opposite the pull through a 1.1 s keyframed hop and smaller rebound with squash-and-stretch, its shadow fading with height.
adapt: The flight is the `frames` array played by `animate` over 1100 ms on both `ball` and `shadow`; tune the `at` offsets, `sx`/`sy` squash, the 1.35 throw multiplier and `height`. The ±65 px pull clamp lives in `onPointerMove`; restyle `.sf-launch-ball`.
